name: Caster's Shield, Greater
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 131
Aura moderate abjuration CL 11th
Slot shield; Price 10,153 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This +3 light wooden shield acts in all ways like a caster’s shield, but the strip can accommodate spells of up to 5th level.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Scribe Scroll; Price 5,153 gp
